Description: Fictional private repair archive - retains the bucket and its transport policy while readers rehearse change review without deployment.

must: Study only; never deploy this template as a lab shortcut
Retained objects need a named owner and explicit cleanup decision
Retain the transport policy with the bucket during stack deletion or replacement; verify actual policy after a live change

ref.has: Fictional workload, change decisions, and limits

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Stores fictional repair records; retention keeps the old physical bucket available for an explicit migration decision rather than silently deleting it.
must: Keep public access blocked and encryption enabled
Do not claim objects moved when a replacement bucket appears

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Refuses non-TLS requests; retention keeps this separate policy with the old archive when the bucket is retained or replaced.
must: Keep the non-TLS deny scoped to the archive bucket and its objects
Retain the old policy when its bucket target changes; inspect effective access and orphan cleanup separately

ArchiveBucketName.Description: Physical bucket name after a deployed stack exists; this study creates no stack.
